notice: Project entries are working scopes and research intentions. They do not imply peer-reviewed publications, completed simulations, or verified original results.

projects.title: Hydrogen in Toroidal Confinement
projects.summary: Explore how an electron bound to a proton behaves within an idealized three-dimensional solid-torus domain, and how a prescribed attosecond field changes its dynamics.
projects.question: Can a self-adjoint confined Coulomb model be defined and numerically converged before introducing a pulsed field?
projects.next_step: Specify torus geometry, nuclear location and boundary conditions; reproduce the field-free limit and perform grid/basis convergence.
projects.validation: Check Hermiticity, norm conservation, ground-state convergence and justified free-space or limiting-geometry benchmarks.

projects.title: Attosecond-Driven Electron Dynamics
projects.summary: Study time-resolved electronic transitions under finite electromagnetic pulses, beginning with solvable or independently reproducible quantum models.
projects.question: Which transition probabilities and observables are stable under basis, time-step and pulse-parameter refinement?
projects.next_step: Benchmark a weak-field hydrogen transition or a driven oscillator before adding geometric confinement.
projects.validation: Compare perturbative limits, conserve probability and report spectral bandwidth and physical units.

projects.title: Symbolic Quantum Mechanics with Mathematica
projects.summary: Develop a systematic symbolic workflow for quantum-mechanical operators, eigenvalue equations, special functions, angular momentum and verification of closed-form solutions.
projects.question: How can symbolic calculations be independently checked rather than taken as black-box outputs?
projects.next_step: Create a notebook that verifies harmonic-oscillator commutators, hydrogen radial states and normalization integrals.
projects.validation: Verify residuals, assumptions, operator domains, dimensional consistency and independent limiting cases.

projects.title: Differential Equations & Spectral Methods
projects.summary: Build analytical and numerical foundations in ODEs, PDEs, Sturm–Liouville problems, Green functions and conservative finite-difference schemes.
projects.question: How accurately do numerical spectra and evolution schemes reproduce analytically solvable boundary-value problems?
projects.next_step: Reproduce the constant-diffusivity heat equation and compare variable-diffusivity numerical solvers.
projects.validation: Track mesh/time-step convergence, self-adjointness and energy dissipation identities.

projects.title: Positive Geometry & Canonical Forms
projects.summary: Learn positive Grassmannians, oriented boundaries, canonical logarithmic forms and the amplituhedron construction through worked mathematical examples.
projects.question: Can canonical forms and their residues be derived and checked for elementary positive geometries?
projects.next_step: Verify canonical forms of intervals and triangles, then work through a nontrivial Grassmannian example.
projects.validation: Check boundary orientations, residues and references against original literature.

projects.title: AI for Scientific Computation
projects.summary: Explore machine-learning tools for scientific surrogates, data fitting and physics-constrained models while keeping numerical ground truth as the reference.
projects.question: When does a learned approximation improve computation without hiding physical or numerical errors?
projects.next_step: Select a simple ODE/PDE benchmark and compare a conventional solver with a small neural surrogate.
projects.validation: Separate train/test regimes and report generalization error, conservation residuals and compute cost.

projects.title: Quantum Algorithms & Simulation
projects.summary: Build small, reproducible quantum-computing demonstrations before considering variational or optimization extensions.
projects.question: Which small quantum algorithms can be verified against exact classical state-vector calculations?
projects.next_step: Implement one- and two-qubit gates, Bell-state generation and measurements; validate against analytical predictions.
projects.validation: Check unitarity, measurement probabilities and classical simulator agreement; distinguish ideal circuits from hardware noise.
